content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the core code passing user data (udata) from a create command to the driver destroy function without clearing it first. This led to the driver misinterpreting the create udata as destroy udata, which could result in resource leaks, particularly in the case of the EFA driver. The patch addresses this by ensuring that the udata is cleared before invoking the destroy function, preventing the driver from processing stale or incorrect data.
